briefTitle: A Study of PRMT5 Inhibitor BAY 3713372 in Participants With MTAP-deleted Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Participant must be ≥ 18 years old of age, or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction of the country in which the study takes place, at the time of signing the informed consent.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Participant must be ≥ 18 years old of age, or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction of the country in which the study takes place, at the time of signing the informed consent.

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: MTAP-deleted Solid Tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This trial is for solid tumors in general, not explicitly limited to stage III/IV non-small cell lung cancer.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable lesion that would qualify as target lesion by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Homozygous MTAP-deletion identified through molecular testing from a locally certified laboratory.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no typed kind for MTAP status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Previous additional cancer other than the one evaluated in this study within the past 2 years except for basal or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, superficial bladder tumors, localized prostate cancer or other tumors that in the opinion of the investigator, are considered cured or not immediately life-threatening, and will not interfere with the scientific goals of this study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior cancer history with investigator discretion exceptions is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A marked prolongation of QT/QTc interval at screening (e.g., repeated demonstration of a QTc interval >450 ms). Participants with permanent pacemakers (i.e., a paced rhythm) may be eligible based on the investigator's clinical assessment and discretion.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTc interval cutoff with investigator discretion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of congestive heart failure Class >II according to the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. Myocardial infarction less than 6 months before the start of study intervention. Serious cardiac arrhythmias requiring treatment or any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction or morphology on resting ECG with the exception of atrial fibrillation which is well-controlled and requires only digoxin or beta blockers.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac history and NYHA functional class rules are not mapped to typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Unstable angina within 4 weeks before start of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unstable angina washout window is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A Study of PRMT5 Inhibitor BAY 3713372 in Participants With MTAP-deleted Solid Tumors
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This trial is for all solid tumors with MTAP deletion, not specifically limited to non-small cell lung cancer, but remains in scope as it evaluates solid tumors.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable lesion that would qualify as target lesion by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Homozygous MTAP-deletion identified through molecular testing from a locally certified laboratory.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: MTAP deletion is not one of the allowed biomarker kinds (egfr_status, alk_status, kras_status, ros1_status, braf_status, pdl1_min, pdl1_max).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Previous additional cancer other than the one evaluated in this study within the past 2 years except for basal or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, superficial bladder tumors, localized prostate cancer or other tumors that in the opinion of the investigator, are considered cured or not immediately life-threatening, and will not interfere with the scientific goals of this study.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy exclusions with investigator discretion and multiple exceptions cannot be expressed as simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A marked prolongation of QT/QTc interval at screening (e.g., repeated demonstration of a QTc interval >450 ms). Participants with permanent pacemakers (i.e., a paced rhythm) may be eligible based on the investigator's clinical assessment and discretion.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTc prolongation with pacemaker exceptions and investigator discretion is not a standard typed lab check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of congestive heart failure Class >II according to the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. Myocardial infarction less than 6 months before the start of study intervention. Serious cardiac arrhythmias requiring treatment or any clinically important abnormalities in rhythm, conduction or morphology on resting ECG with the exception of atrial fibrillation which is well-controlled and requires only digoxin or beta blockers.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex cardiac history exclusions including NYHA class and arrhythmia details are not covered by typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Unstable angina within 4 weeks before start of study intervention.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unstable angina with a washout window is not a typed check.
